ad.body: Understand downtime and keep your operation moving.

page.headline: The #1 Dashboard for Factory Performance
page.body: Northline gives plant teams one place to understand downtime.

personas.name: Klaus
personas.quote: A '#1' with no number behind it tells me nothing.
personas.reason: Objects to slogans without proof — and there is no price on the page.

personas.name: Anika
personas.quote: No price anywhere. I am not clicking just to find out.
personas.reason: Will not click when the price is missing.

personas.name: Mateo
personas.quote: Who says you are #1? There is no source.

personas.name: Jules
personas.quote: Wait, this is a hot OS for my side hustle.
personas.reason: Thinks the factory dashboard is a consumer app — clicks, but will never buy.
